D01,2026-04,2600,1690
D02,2026-04,1700,1020
D03,2026-04,900,630
D04,2026-04,500,
"""

print("【模拟数据】订单明细清洗（非真实公司经营数据）")
print("=" * 60)

# ---- 类型与派生字段 ----

clean["cost"] = clean["cost"].astype(float)
clean["gross_profit"] = clean["revenue"] - clean["cost"]

print(f"毛利为负的有效订单数(保留): {len(neg)}")
if len(neg) > 0:
    print("负毛利订单 order_id:", neg["order_id"].tolist())

clean = clean.sort_values(["month", "order_id"]).reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"清洗后总成本: {clean['cost'].sum():.2f} 元")
print(f"清洗后总毛利: {clean['gross_profit'].sum():.2f} 元")

# ---- 落盘 ----

print("已写出: clean.csv")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
步骤2：读取 clean.csv，按 month 汇总生成 monthly_summary.csv
数据性质：模拟数据（非真实公司经营数据）
金额单位：元
本步骤只读取 clean.csv，不重新生成原始数据。
"""
import os
import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# 中文字体（本机可用 Microsoft YaHei / SimHei）
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

INPUT_FILE = "clean.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "monthly_summary.csv"
TOL = 1e-8

# ---------- 1. 读取前序产物 clean.csv（缺失则报错，禁止重造数据） ----------
if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    sys.exit(f"[ERROR] 缺少约定输入文件 {INPUT_FILE}，本步骤不重造数据，终止。")

clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)
print(f"[INFO] 已读取 {INPUT_FILE}，行数={len(clean)}，列={list(clean.columns)}")

required_cols = {"order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"}
missing_cols = required_cols - set(clean.columns)
if missing_cols:
    sys.exit(f"[ERROR] clean.csv 缺少必要列: {missing_cols}")

# ---------- 2. 防御性检查：确认 clean.csv 已清洗（不重复计数、无缺失收入/成本） ----------
dup_cnt = int(clean["order_id"].duplicated().sum())
print(f"[CHECK] clean.csv 中重复 order_id 数 = {dup_cnt}（应为 0，避免重复计数）")
if dup_cnt != 0:
    sys.exit("[ERROR] clean.csv 仍含重复 order_id，血缘异常，终止。")

na_rev = int(clean["revenue"].isna().sum())
na_cost = int(clean["cost"].isna().sum())
print(f"[CHECK] clean.csv 中 revenue 缺失数 = {na_rev}，cost 缺失数 = {na_cost}（应为 0，避免用 0 冒充真实收入）")
if na_rev != 0 or na_cost != 0:
    sys.exit("[ERROR] clean.csv 仍含缺失 revenue/cost，终止。")

# 毛利为负的有效订单必须保留（不剔除）
neg_mask = (clean["revenue"] - clean["cost"]) < 0
print(f"[CHECK] clean.csv 中毛利为负的有效订单数 = {int(neg_mask.sum())}（按规则保留，不剔除）")

# ---------- 3. 按 month 汇总（毛利=总收入-总成本；毛利率=总毛利/总收入，禁止平均单笔毛利率） ----------
clean = clean.copy()
clean["gross_profit"] = clean["revenue"] - clean["cost"]

monthly = (
    clean.groupby("month", as_index=False)
    .agg(
        revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
        cost=("cost", "sum"),
        orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
    )
    .sort_values("month")
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

monthly["gross_profit"] = monthly["revenue"] - monthly["cost"]
# 毛利率 = 总毛利 / 总收入（加权口径），避免平均单笔毛利率造成加权错误
monthly["gross_margin"] = np.where(
    monthly["revenue"] != 0,
    monthly["gross_profit"] / monthly["revenue"],
    np.nan,
)

# 列名严格为 month,revenue,cost,gross_profit,gross_margin,orders
monthly = monthly[["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]]

print("\n[RESULT] 月度汇总（模拟数据，金额单位：元）")
print(monthly.to_string(index=False))

# ---------- 4. 核对：按月汇总之和 == 清洗明细合计（绝对容差 1e-8） ----------
sum_rev_detail = float(clean["revenue"].sum())
sum_cost_detail = float(clean["cost"].sum())
sum_gp_detail = float(clean["gross_profit"].sum())

sum_rev_month = float(monthly["revenue"].sum())
sum_cost_month = float(monthly["cost"].sum())
sum_gp_month = float(monthly["gross_profit"].sum())

ok_rev = abs(sum_rev_detail - sum_rev_month) <= TOL
ok_cost = abs(sum_cost_detail - sum_cost_month) <= TOL
ok_gp = abs(sum_gp_detail - sum_gp_month) <= TOL
print(f"\n[VERIFY] 收入合计 明细={sum_rev_detail:.6f} 汇总={sum_rev_month:.6f} 一致={ok_rev}")
print(f"[VERIFY] 成本合计 明细={sum_cost_detail:.6f} 汇总={sum_cost_month:.6f} 一致={ok_cost}")
print(f"[VERIFY] 毛利合计 明细={sum_gp_detail:.6f} 汇总={sum_gp_month:.6f} 一致={ok_gp}")

# 毛利率口径核对：总毛利 / 总收入
overall_margin = sum_gp_month / sum_rev_month if sum_rev_month != 0 else np.nan
print(f"[VERIFY] 整体毛利率(总毛利/总收入) = {overall_margin:.6f}")

if not (ok_rev and ok_cost and ok_gp):
    sys.exit("[ERROR] 汇总与明细不一致，终止落盘。")

# ---------- 5. 落盘 ----------
monthly.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(f"\n[SAVED] {OUTPUT_FILE}（模拟数据，金额单位：元）")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

INPUT_FILE = "clean.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "monthly_summary.csv"
TOL = 1e-8

# ---------- 1. 读取前序产物 clean.csv（缺失则报错，禁止重造数据） ----------
if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    sys.exit(f"[ERROR] 缺少约定输入文件 {INPUT_FILE}，本步骤不重造数据，终止。")

clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)
print(f"[INFO] 已读取 {INPUT_FILE}，行数={len(clean)}，列={list(clean.columns)}")

required_cols = {"order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"}
missing_cols = required_cols - set(clean.columns)
if missing_cols:
    sys.exit(f"[ERROR] clean.csv 缺少必要列: {missing_cols}")

# ---------- 2. 防御性检查：确认 clean.csv 已清洗（不重复计数、无缺失收入/成本） ----------
dup_cnt = int(clean["order_id"].duplicated().sum())
print(f"[CHECK] clean.csv 中重复 order_id 数 = {dup_cnt}（应为 0，避免重复计数）")
if dup_cnt != 0:
    sys.exit("[ERROR] clean.csv 仍含重复 order_id，血缘异常，终止。")

na_rev = int(clean["revenue"].isna().sum())
na_cost = int(clean["cost"].isna().sum())
print(f"[CHECK] clean.csv 中 revenue 缺失数 = {na_rev}，cost 缺失数 = {na_cost}（应为 0，避免用 0 冒充真实收入）")
if na_rev != 0 or na_cost != 0:
    sys.exit("[ERROR] clean.csv 仍含缺失 revenue/cost，终止。")

neg_mask = (clean["revenue"] - clean["cost"]) < 0

    .agg(

        cost=("cost", "sum"),
        orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
    )
    .sort_values("month")
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

monthly["gross_margin"] = np.where(
    monthly["revenue"] != 0,
    monthly["gross_profit"] / monthly["revenue"],
    np.nan,
)

# 列名严格为 month,revenue,cost,gross_profit,gross_margin,orders
monthly = monthly[["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]]

print("\n[RESULT] 月度汇总（模拟数据，金额单位：元）")
print(monthly.to_string(index=False))

sum_rev_detail = float(clean["revenue"].sum())
sum_cost_detail = float(clean["cost"].sum())
sum_gp_detail = float(clean["gross_profit"].sum())

sum_rev_month = float(monthly["revenue"].sum())
sum_cost_month = float(monthly["cost"].sum())
sum_gp_month = float(monthly["gross_profit"].sum())

ok_rev = abs(sum_rev_detail - sum_rev_month) <= TOL
ok_cost = abs(sum_cost_detail - sum_cost_month) <= TOL
ok_gp = abs(sum_gp_detail - sum_gp_month) <= TOL
print(f"\n[VERIFY] 收入合计 明细={sum_rev_detail:.6f} 汇总={sum_rev_month:.6f} 一致={ok_rev}")
print(f"[VERIFY] 成本合计 明细={sum_cost_detail:.6f} 汇总={sum_cost_month:.6f} 一致={ok_cost}")
print(f"[VERIFY] 毛利合计 明细={sum_gp_detail:.6f} 汇总={sum_gp_month:.6f} 一致={ok_gp}")

# 毛利率口径核对：总毛利 / 总收入
overall_margin = sum_gp_month / sum_rev_month if sum_rev_month != 0 else np.nan
print(f"[VERIFY] 整体毛利率(总毛利/总收入) = {overall_margin:.6f}")

if not (ok_rev and ok_cost and ok_gp):
    sys.exit("[ERROR] 汇总与明细不一致，终止落盘。")

# ---------- 5. 落盘 ----------
monthly.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(f"\n[SAVED] {OUTPUT_FILE}（模拟数据，金额单位：元）")

INPUT_SUMMARY = 'monthly_summary.csv'

OUT_FIG = 'figure.svg'
OUT_REPORT = 'report.md'

    if not os.path.exists(f):

df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_SUMMARY)
required_cols = ['month', 'revenue', 'cost', 'gross_profit', 'gross_margin', 'orders']
missing = [c for c in required_cols if c not in df.columns]
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"monthly_summary.csv 缺少列：{missing}")
df = df.sort_values('month').reset_index(drop=True)

clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_CLEAN)

cost_sum = float(clean['cost'].sum())
orders_sum = int(len(clean))

cost_m = float(df['cost'].sum())
orders_m = int(df['orders'].sum())
tol = 1e-8

chk_cost = abs(cost_sum - cost_m) <= tol
chk_ord = orders_sum == orders_m
print("=== 血缘一致性核对（clean.csv vs monthly_summary.csv）===")

total_rev = rev_m
total_cost = cost_m

total_margin = total_gp / total_rev if total_rev else float('nan')
neg_months = df[df['gross_profit'] < 0]['month'].tolist()

for _, r in df.iterrows():

# ---------- 趋势图（矢量 SVG） ----------

ax1.bar(x + 0.2, df['cost'], width=0.4, label='成本(元)', color='#DD8452')

ax1.set_ylabel('金额（元）')
ax1.set_title('月度收入/成本与毛利率趋势（模拟数据，单位：元）')

ax2.set_ylabel('毛利率（%）')

lines2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax1.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper left', fontsize=8)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(OUT_FIG, format='svg')
plt.close(fig)
print(f"已生成矢量图：{OUT_FIG}")

# ---------- 管理层报告 ----------
risk_lines = []
if neg_months:
    risk_lines.append(f"- 毛利为负月份：{', '.join(neg_months)}，存在亏损风险，需核查定价与成本结构。")
